scopeNotes: PhlimboV3.sol + MigratorV2V3.sol are NEW (story-022/023). Phlimbo.sol (V1) 'changed' commit eec95e5 is cosmetic-only (forge fmt reflow + a deprecation comment 'safe to delete after V3 ships'); no functional delta, so V1's Linear-Depletion bug (ledger M-04, acknowledged/retired) is NOT re-reported. PhlimboV2/MigratorV1V2 read as unchanged context.

findings.description: The phUSD reward stream is minted on demand with NO funded-budget cap, unlike the stable stream. In _updatePool the phUSD accrual is `phUSDReward = timeElapsed * phUSDPerSecond` (L744-746) with no cap against any balance, and _claimRewards mints it via `phUSD.mint(beneficiary, pendingPhUSDAmount)` (L781-784). Contrast the stable stream, which is explicitly capped at `rewardBalance` (L730) and the promo stream capped at `promoRewardBalance` (L756). phUSD emission rate is `totalStaked * desiredAPYBps / 10000 / SECONDS_PER_YEAR` (L831). This is APY-driven inflation of the protocol's own mintable token — structurally identical to the V1/V2 phUSD-mint-authority concern.
missingMitigations: No per-window emission cap on the phUSD leg (stable/promo legs ARE capped)
vulnerableWhenMatched: per-call mint amount derived from user-influenceable accounting (amount, elapsed) with no emission cap on the phUSD leg
notVulnerableWhenPresent: single _updatePool writer folds elapsed*rate (no double-mint path found)
findings.knownIssueCrossRef: Reconciles to ledger V2-M-02 (phUSD mint authority load-bearing) and V2-M-03 (memory flags 're-classify HIGH if any non-zero-APY config ships'; zero-APY / KI-10 currently immunizes). Regression check against a known concern — sanitizer to reconcile by fingerprint. Emit at honest severity only if a non-zero-APY config is in scope for this run.

findings.description: migrate() forwards reward deltas to each user with `safeTransfer` (phUSD L187, stable L190, promo L193). A single recipient that cannot receive a token (blocklisted USDC address, reverting fallback) reverts the whole chunk atomically, blocking every user AT AND AFTER that cursor index within the batch. The loop is chunked (maxIterations) so gas is bounded, but a poisoned recipient can wedge a contiguous migration segment. This is the availability-DoS class of ledger V2-M-01 (MigratorV1V2 strict-== precondition brick), re-expressed as a transfer-revert rather than a balance precondition.
missingMitigations: No try/catch or _tryTransfer-style bank around the per-user reward forwarding (contrast V3.batchClaim L459 which uses _tryTransfer + unclaimablePromo banking)
notVulnerableWhenPresent: Documented operational escape: exclude poisoned addresses from the seed list, or reseed a fresh straggler list after the pass completes; withdrawAll recovers stranded balances. No theft — availability + full owner recovery.
findings.knownIssueCrossRef: Same severity envelope as ledger V2-M-01 (Medium: availability only, owner recovery, no theft). Note the ASYMMETRY: V3.batchClaim solved exactly this with _tryTransfer/unclaimablePromo (L816-820) but MigratorV2V3.migrate did NOT adopt the same non-reverting pattern.

manualReview.function: _updatePool (promo block) / startPromotion / topUpPromotion / setPromoDepletionDuration / batchClaim / finalizePromotion
manualReview.description: BRAND-NEW promo reward subsystem in a family where the Linear-Depletion / rate-drift class has recurred (memory: do NOT auto-suppress). Signatures match strongly (accPromoPerShare, promoDebt, promoRewardPerSecond, _updatePool). Static reading suggests the mitigations ARE present: (a) rate is recomputed ONLY in topUpPromotion (L385) and setPromoDepletionDuration (L403) — NOT in _updatePool (L753-762), preserving the V2 bug-fix discipline; (b) promo accrual is capped at promoRewardBalance (L756); (c) every rate/window/balance mutation is preceded by _updatePool at the OLD rate (L347, L375, L399); (d) accPromoPerShare is deliberately never reset across rotations, with debts realigned by the flush so `amount*acc - debt` cannot underflow. Confidence is LOW because the pattern APPLIES (not because impact is small): this is new code in a recurrence-prone class and warrants a code-scanner/econ-scanner reasoning pass over the promo accrual + rotation state machine, NOT dismissal.
manualReview.reasoningTierAsk: Confirm no retroactive promo accrual across (i) startPromotion when totalStaked==0 then first staker, (ii) the finalize→(gap, promoToken==0)→startPromotion re-arm where accPromoPerShare stays non-zero, (iii) pauseWithdraw-during-flush debt realignment vs frozen accumulator. Verify the '_stakers frozen while paused' invariant that batchClaim completeness rests on.

manualReview.description: pauseWithdraw deliberately does NOT touch `_stakers` membership (L534-535 comment) so the set stays frozen during a flush. Consequence: a user who fully exits via pauseWithdraw (amount → 0) REMAINS in `_stakers`, breaking the stated invariant 'membership ⟺ userInfo.amount > 0' (L611-612). Zombie entries are harmless per-flush (batchClaim visits them with pending==0, L452) but accumulate across pause cycles, monotonically inflating the per-rotation flush iteration count / gas the owner must pay to reach `flushCursor == _stakers.length()`. No fund risk; flush is chunked so no hard brick. Surface-for-triage as a Low invariant/operational footgun, not dropped.
manualReview.reasoningTierAsk: Confirm zombie entries can only grow (no self-heal) and quantify whether a griefer can pump _stakers cheaply to raise the owner's finalize cost.

manualReview.description: emergencyTransfer (L307-325) drains all phUSD/reward/promo balances and pauses, but does NOT zero accounting (totalStaked, userInfo.amount, accumulators). After a drain, pauseWithdraw (the documented paused-emergency exit, L537) computes `safeTransfer(msg.sender, amount)` against a zero contract balance and reverts — so the recovery mechanism the docstring promises is unavailable post-drain. This is the F-01 / V2-F-01 spec-conformance issue carried forward verbatim into V3.
manualReview.knownIssueCrossRef: Ledger F-01 (V1) / V2-F-01 (V2), spec-conformance. Confirm it is tracked for V3 rather than re-filed fresh; sanitizer to reconcile.
manualReview.reasoningTierAsk: Route to story-faithfulness / spec-conformance channel, not H/M.

manualReview.description: Two-step APY commit gated by `block.number > pendingAPYBlockNumber + 100` (L224) and `bps == pendingAPYBps` (L225). Step-2 applies the caller's step-2 `bps`, which must equal the snapshotted pendingAPYBps, so the committed value is effectively snapshotted (notVulnerableWhen satisfied) and _updatePool settles at the old rate before the change (L233). onlyOwner throughout (owner trusted, Law 3). Recorded as a low-confidence non-issue for completeness; no third-party re-arm path since it is owner-gated.
manualReview.reasoningTierAsk: Likely non-finding; confirm no owner-surprise footgun in the preview/commit branch selection (block.number>+100 auto-reverts a stale commit to a fresh preview).

manualReview.description: withdrawAll (L216-229) sweeps only phUSD and rewardToken to the owner; it does NOT sweep the promo token. Promo rewards are forwarded per-user in the same atomic loop iteration, so promo should never strand under normal flow, but any promo dust/donation to the migrator is unrecoverable by this escape hatch (would need a fresh migrator deploy). QA-level completeness gap.

checkedNoMatch.reason: No ERC4626 vault / shares==assets*supply/assets accounting; MasterChef accumulator model, not a share-price vault.
No Chainlink/oracle usage in scope. Zero signature hits.
No oracle usage. Zero hits.
All state-changing entrypoints nonReentrant; hooks fire post-state inside the guard; reward transfers are trusted phUSD/stable. promoToken owner-set. No unrestricted ERC777 callback path.
No ecrecover/EIP-712/permit in scope. Zero hits.
No spot-price/reserves/slot0 reads. Rates are time-linear, not price-derived.
int256<->uint256 casts in MigratorV2V3 (migrateIterator) provably bounded by users.length; no narrowing casts.
All rate math multiplies by PRECISION (1e18) before dividing; accPerShare scaled consistently. No div-before-mul on the value path.
Constructor-initialized (Ownable(msg.sender)); no initializer/proxy pattern.
No delegatecall/proxy; plain constructor-deployed contracts.
No swap/exchange; rewards are transfers/mints, not AMM trades.
No ETH handling / balance-dependent logic; all accounting in ERC20 units.
No governance/voting.
No permit().
MINIMUM_STAKE (1e15) enforced; MasterChef accounting (no share-price bootstrap). totalStaked==0 path in _updatePool only advances lastRewardTime, accrues nothing.
Single-chain; no bridge/lzReceive/chainid message auth.
No timelock construct.

batchClaim pays each staker their OWN pending TO THE STAKER (recipient pinned to the staker, L459, not caller-chosen); permissionless but state-fixed. notVulnerableWhen (recipient pinned to non-caller) satisfied. No caller-chosen full-pot payout.
No yieldStrategy/balanceBefore-vs-requested principal split; principal is 1:1 staked phUSD. Migration nets principal exactly (withdraw amount == restake amount).
No NFT / _safeMint / onERC721Received; phUSD/stable/promo are ERC20.
pending* views read frozen accPerShare + user debt; not consumed by external integrators as an oracle. No inconsistent-window value view exposed mid-call.

Single contract-wide ReentrancyGuard across stake/withdraw/claim/collectReward/batchClaim; pauseWithdraw is CEI (state at L542-547 before transfer L549) + whenPaused with no reentrant sibling; phUSD transfer has no callback.

Standard floor division on accPerShare distribution; residual rounds DOWN into rewardBalance/promoRewardBalance (protocol/leftoverRecipient), swept at finalize. No user-favouring round-trip; rewards are pull-accrual not deposit/redeem round-trips.
block.timestamp used only for time-linear accrual (lastRewardTime/timeElapsed), never for a value-bearing random outcome. No rarity/lottery/winner selection.

startPromotion/topUpPromotion explicitly reject fee-on-transfer via balance-delta assertion (L351-354, L379-382). Stable collectReward credits requested amount but token set is the known non-fee stable (documented OOS). Promo token owner-vetted.

patternsSkipped.reason: Pattern note: C4 treats approve front-running as QA/known-issue. Only site is MigratorV2V3.forceApprove(phlimboV3, max) to a TRUSTED internal contract (L144) — no user approve non-zero->non-zero, no plausible HM twist. Skipped from primary findings per SKIP RULE; no manualReview escalation warranted.

Pattern note: C4 treats centralization as Low/QA unless it enables a rug. Many onlyOwner setters (setMigrator/setHook/setPauser/setDesiredAPY/promo lifecycle/emergencyTransfer). Owner trusted for KNOWING actions (Law 3) — suppressed as noise. Non-obvious owner FOOTGUNS surfaced separately: emergencyTransfer->pauseWithdraw brick (PM-005) and the phUSD non-zero-APY over-mint concern (PM-001) are routed at honest severity rather than as generic centralization.

Not skipped as a class — surfaced twice in manualReview (PM-005 emergencyTransfer/pauseWithdraw spec gap, PM-007 withdrawAll promo sweep). Elsewhere all ERC20 calls use SafeERC20; batchClaim._tryTransfer (L816-820) correctly checks the low-level return. Listed here for completeness of disposition.

coverageNotes: All 5 in-scope .sol files readable. V1 (Phlimbo.sol) confirmed cosmetic-only change vs eec95e5~1 (forge fmt + deprecation comment) — no functional re-scan needed; its Linear-Depletion bug remains ledger M-04 (acknowledged, retired). Primary analytical surface = PhlimboV3.sol (promo subsystem + rotation state machine) and MigratorV2V3.sol (live-read chunked migration + reward-delta bracketing).
